theme_and_archetype.description: A modern luxury design combining deep charcoal and obsidian blacks with warm metallic gold accents. It balances the high-end VIP concierge feel with the rugged, snowy atmosphere of Whistler, BC. The aesthetic relies on spatial depth, bento-grid layouts, dark-first tonal elevation, and refined glassmorphism rather than flat blocks.

body.style: clean, highly legible, generous line height

grid_system.bento_asymmetric: Mix of col-span-12, col-span-8, col-span-4 for a magazine-like layout
grid_system.cards: Dense 'Control Room' grids for the many activity cards (ATV, Bungee, Golf) to ensure they are scannable but distinct.

layout_and_spacing.mobile_first: Ensure tap targets (buttons, links) are at least 48px. Use a floating or fixed bottom action bar for primary conversions (Book / Call / WhatsApp).

glassmorphism.usage: Sticky headers, floating action buttons (FABs), bottom navigation sheets.

cards.usage: Activity cards, restaurant features, loyalty program.
cards.classes: bg-[#121418] border border-white/5 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-gold/40 transition-all duration-300 shadow-lg

tracing_beam.usage: FIFA 2026 Countdown section, premium VIP transfer highlight.
tracing_beam.classes: relative overflow-hidden group border border-white/10, utilizing a subtle moving gradient background mask for high-tech luxury.

component_instructions.hero_section: Dark atmospheric hero image of a luxury SUV in snow, heavily overlaid (bg-black/50) to allow the Gold text and FIFA 2026 countdown to pop. Phone CTA must be the primary visual hook.
component_instructions.instant_fare_calculator: A sleek, bento-style widget. Use Shadcn Inputs and Select components stripped of their generic styles, customized with deep charcoal backgrounds, white/10 borders, and gold focus rings.
component_instructions.booking_form: Mobile-optimized. Group fields logically. Primary 'Book Now' button should be metallic gold background with black text. Include visual placements for Apple Pay / Google Pay at checkout.
component_instructions.floating_action_buttons: A vertical stack or bottom fixed bar on mobile. Call (Gold), WhatsApp (Green), SMS (White). Include phone number '778-917-3030' in text form clearly visible near the top and bottom.
component_instructions.activities_grid: 20+ items. Use an asymmetric grid. Some items span 2 columns, some 1. Use images for high-ticket items (Helicopter, ATV), icon-only for minor features. Cards must have 'Book Transport' gold text CTAs.
component_instructions.loyalty_program: A dark card with 10 visual 'stamps'. The 11th stamp is a gold icon (Free Ride). Add text: 'Airport transfers = 2 stamps'.
component_instructions.award_badges: For restaurants. Create a small absolute positioned badge top-right of the card: `bg-gradient-to-br from-[#D4AF37] to-[#8C6D1F] text-black text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-sm shadow-md`.
component_instructions.testimonials: Use `react-fast-marquee` (or similar smooth infinite scroll) for a luxury editorial ribbon feel. Very slow movement. Cards should be dark tonal grey with white/5 borders.

icons.instruction: Use thin, elegant strokes (strokeWidth 1.5). For luxury accents, color icons in gold (#D4AF37).

image_urls.description: Black luxury SUV in snow for the hero background
Whistler mountain winter landscape for parallax or section breaks

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons should have a slight scale up (scale-105) and an increase in brightness on hover. Text colors must maintain high contrast.
motion_and_interactions.reveal_animations: Use stagger-children for bento grid cards so they cascade in beautifully as the user scrolls. Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered fades.
motion_and_interactions.loyalty_stamps: Add a subtle 'stamp' animation (pop and fade) for the loyalty tracker visual.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure white text over gold buttons has enough contrast, otherwise use black text on gold backgrounds.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: Add data-testid to all interactive elements, e.g., data-testid='book-now-button', data-testid='whatsapp-fab', data-testid='fare-calculator-submit'.
